question: Will Shohei Ohtani hit at least 43 home runs in 2026?
resolution_criteria:

The MLB regular season will end on September 27, 2026.

- His 2026 pace was slower: 30 HR through about 121 games by Aug. 18, roughly 0.25 per game.
- Hitting 13 home runs in about four games has never happened in MLB. The single-game record is 4 HR. Even at his best pace (about 0.34 HR per game in 2025), he would average about 1.4 home runs in four games.

Left knee soreness was also a factor, and he had not improved enough over the previous week. [NBC Los Angeles](https://www.nbclosangeles.com/news/sports/shohei-ohtani-dodgers-injured-list/3940031/); [MLB.com](https://www.mlb.com/news/shohei-ohtani-out-of-lineup-again-vs-reds)

- His recent full seasons: 46 (2021), 34 (2022), 44 (2023), 54 (2024), 55 (2025). His 2026 pace was clearly lower, at about 30 through Aug. 18.
- His best home run month is about 15. Even at his peak he averaged roughly one home run every 3 to 4 games.
- The MLB record for one month is 20 (Sammy Sosa, June 1998), and the record for one game is 4. No player has ever hit 13 in about five games, so the historical base rate is effectively 0%.
